subject: Number of progeny required for QTL mapping?

messages.author: ba3b508d5a663f81
messages.subject: Number of progeny required for QTL mapping?
parts: I am wondering if anyone knows a formula which can be used to predict the number of progeny required to find QTLs? I think it will need to take into account the genetic difference or number of SNPs between the two parents, and also the recombination frequency if known already. I am thinking of deriving this formula but maybe someone here knows?
